title: test(components): pin a declared danger action on action:bar to the app-todo shape
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8UhZd4buJ9P8RHCa2Rnbx4C)_

Fixes #26781

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:只新增一个测试文件,用 app-todo 的 `delete_completed`(危险操作)原样形状驱动 `action:bar`,钉住按钮画成红色(destructive)、确认框按钮也是红色。
- 为什么改:代码修复已随 #26966 合入,但没有任何测试经过 `action:bar` 走这条路径,卡要求「在 app-todo 形状上钉住」。
- 风险与回滚:零运行时风险,只加测试;回滚即删这一个文件。
- 先看:`ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-bar-danger-variant-26781.test.tsx`(三个用例:危险按钮样式、对照按钮、确认框选项)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/action-bar-danger-variant-26781.test.tsx`,预期 3 passed。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One new test file, `action-bar-danger-variant-26781.test.tsx`, under `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/action/__tests__/`. No source change.

It renders an `action:bar` shaped like the list page's toolbar (`objectViewHeaderToolbar.ts`: `location: 'list_toolbar'`, `size: 'sm'`, `variant: 'outline'`) carrying two actions copied key for key from `examples/app-todo` (`DeleteCompletedAction` and `ExportToCsvAction`, `ai` block included), and asserts:

1. the `delete_completed` member (`variant: 'danger'`) draws with the Button primitive's destructive style (`bg-destructive`, not the bar's outline);
2. CONTROL: `export_csv` in the same bar declares no variant and draws the bar's `outline`;
3. clicking `delete_completed` asks its `confirmText` through the confirm handler with `{ title, confirmText: label, destructive: true }`, and the script handler is not run on a cancel.

## Why

The code path landed with #26966 (`toButtonVariant` maps `danger` to the primitive's `destructive`; `toRunnerVariant` forwards `danger` to the runner, whose confirm paints destructive). The existing `danger` pins (`action-variant-confirm-26665.test.tsx`) drive `action:button` / icon / group / menu directly; nothing drove a declared `danger` action through `action:bar`, which is where a list toolbar action reaches the screen. The card's Wanted asks for that pin on the app-todo shape.

## Tests

- New file: 3 passed (vitest, `dom` project), run from the `ui/` root.
- Ablation A (one-shot, restored): `toButtonVariant` `case 'danger'` returns `default` ⇒ test 1 red (`expected '…' to contain 'bg-destructive'`), 2 passed; restore verified (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty).
- Ablation B (one-shot, restored): `toRunnerVariant` drops its `danger` case ⇒ test 3 red (options lose `destructive`), 2 passed; restore verified the same way.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components run type-check` exit 0 (its `tsconfig.test.json` includes `src/**/*.test.tsx`).

## Acceptance notes

- The confirm is read from the confirm handler's call, the input the host's `ActionConfirmDialog` (`@object-ui/app-shell`) draws from. `@object-ui/components` cannot import app-shell, so the dialog's own button class is not rendered here; this is the same layer the 26665 pins read.
